name: @extas/messages
description: The Messages control centre's engine (S05, CN-019): PR 148 — the order journey's messages by SMS, WhatsApp and e-mail, planned from the order timeline, with the no-double-send guard, caps per order, quiet hours, the amount-due rule (SIM-F-001), the WhatsApp self-confirm (CN-014 idea 5) and the exact-amount line (idea 10). Every channel runs on its mock until the owner types a key in.
